name: onsemi
description: onsemi makes power chips (silicon, silicon carbide and GaN), analog and mixed-signal chips and image sensors, sold mainly for cars (electric-vehicle power and driver-assistance sensors), industrial equipment and AI data-center power. It owns fabs, so utilization matters: revenue fell 15% in 2025 to $6.0B as automotive and industrial demand weakened, gross margin dropped from 45.4% to 33.1%, and operating income collapsed to $84M after $496M of non-cash impairments on manufacturing investments and restructuring (about 2,400 jobs cut). Over half (54%) of sales go through distributors. Customers design the part in, then buy per unit; Power Solutions (PSG) is the biggest segment but the least profitable per dollar, while Analog and Mixed-Signal (AMG) earns a 51% gross margin.
